title: Yasinia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Perhaps it is a place name, the one cited in [Zevachim 112a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.112a.9) as Rav Chiya of Yushehinia.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Beitzah gives Yose bar Yasinia. Bekhorot 47b gives Shimon Yasinia without a patronymic particle. Zevachim names Rav Chiyya of Yustinya. The suggestion that Yasinia is a place is Hyman’s.
